cases.input: Two decisions cite the same issued source expression through separate locators and stances.
cases.expect: One source expression and two immutable citation acts remain independently resolvable.

cases.input: A cited source is later retracted.
cases.expect: A source status event is appended; citations and decisions preserve history and separately reassess their premises.

cases.input: A source publishes a corrected edition.
cases.expect: A successor expression is linked without changing the digest or identity of the earlier consulted expression.

cases.input: A document URL is treated as proof that the citing claim is true.
cases.expect: The inference is rejected: the URL is neither fixed source identity nor truth assessment.

cases.input: Retraction causes old citations, dissent and rationale to be deleted.
cases.expect: Deletion is rejected; prior states remain resolvable and new assessments append.
